summary: This bill prohibits federal funding and tax-exempt status for nonprofit organizations if one of their officers or board members is convicted of certain federal offenses, such as assaulting a federal officer or rioting, while serving in that capacity.

scores.thoughts: This bill imposes penalties on nonprofit entities if their officers or board members are convicted of certain federal offenses (assaulting federal officers or rioting) while serving in their capacity. This directly relates to stricter justice by penalizing organizations for the criminal conduct of their leadership.
